A Kennedy relative talks about his family's lawsuit against Trump's 250-foot arch

By Scott Detrow, Erika Ryan, Patrick Jarenwattananon

Wednesday, November 11, 2026 • 4:05 PM EST

Heard on All Things Considered

NPR's Scott Detrow speaks with Max Kennedy, son of Robert Kennedy Sr., about the Kennedy family's lawsuit to halt the construction of President Trump's 250-foot arch near Arlington National Cemetery.
